data.long_meaning: The name Derrick is believed to have originated from the Old English word 'dryhtric,' which can be broken down into 'dryht,' meaning 'warrior,' and 'ric,' meaning 'ruler' or 'power.' Thus, the name can be interpreted as 'warrior ruler' or 'ruler of the war band.'. The name Derrick carries the meaning “Derived from 'dry wreath'” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Derrick usually hope their child will grow to embody derived from 'dry wreath' and live with faith, good character and purpose.
